name: Seated barbell press
notes: Record the seated barbell press as one movement.

guide.setup: Set up the seated barbell press with a stable base and a comfortable range of motion. Use a load and setup appropriate for your experience.
guide.execution: Perform each repetition of the seated barbell press smoothly, then return to the starting position under control.
guide.cues: Keep the ribs and pelvis controlled, move deliberately, and stop if you cannot maintain the intended position.
guide.mistakes: Using momentum, shortening the range, or choosing more load than you can control.
